scenarios.title: The milestone branch row gives the milestone name command
scenarios.notes: Risk: the row drifts from the spec, or the command fails when run. Read the row in _common.md. Run the command with a real milestone id. The output must be ok with a branch that follows branchFormat.

scenarios.title: The e2e branch row takes the milestone id and no area
scenarios.notes: Risk: the row gains an --area argument, or mixes up the e2e and e2e-area kinds. Check the row text. Run the command with a milestone id only. Compare the output with the e2e-area output: the two names must differ.

scenarios.title: The e2e area branch row takes a milestone id and an area id
scenarios.notes: Risk: the row loses --area, or an area id with odd characters gives a bad name. Run the command with a plain area id and with a hyphenated one. Run it without --area: branches.py must refuse it with a clear error.

scenarios.title: The state branch row takes no id and makes the timestamp
scenarios.notes: Risk: the row asks for --id, or the command needs one. Run the command with no --id. The name must hold a timestamp. Run it twice and check that each name is well formed. Check that the row says the command makes the timestamp.

scenarios.title: The attempt branch row takes a slice id and an attempt number
scenarios.notes: Risk: the row loses --n, or a bad n (zero, negative, text, huge) gives a bad name. Run the command with n = 2. Try n = 0, -1 and abc: branches.py must refuse or give a valid name, never a malformed one.

scenarios.title: Every row of the placeholder table is complete and runs
scenarios.notes: Risk: a row is missing, split in two cells wrongly, or the table has a row the tests do not run. Count the rows (eight placeholders). Run each name command with sample ids. Check that the STE check on _common.md still passes.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py name for each kind in a scratch repo with a branchFormat and check the output, exit code and tree.
Call the branches.py name function with generated ids, area ids and attempt numbers.

riskReason: The slice adds five string-match tests and may leave _common.md unchanged; no runtime code changes.
notes: The slice is a prompt table plus tests. The cli and contract profiles cover it. Other profiles cannot observe a markdown table. The security profile is not tagged: branches.py was covered in earlier slices and this slice adds no input path.
